title: Lemon-Herb Vinaigrette
summary: Fresh lemon juice and zest with shallot and a touch of mustard, shaken with olive oil and finished with parsley, chives and thyme.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Mellow the shallot
steps.text: Put the lemon juice and chopped shallot in the jar and leave them for 5 min. The acid softens the raw sharpness of the shallot.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Add the lemon zest, mustard, salt and pepper. The mustard helps hold the oil and lemon together.

steps.title: Shake to emulsify
steps.text: Pour in the olive oil, close the lid tightly and shake hard for about 30 seconds, until the dressing turns cloudy and thickens a little.

steps.title: Add the herbs
steps.text: Add the parsley, chives and thyme and give the jar another quick shake.

steps.title: Taste and dress
steps.text: Dip a lettuce leaf in to taste, adjusting the salt or lemon. Pour into a small jug and dress the salad just before it goes to the table so the leaves stay crisp.

tips: Shake again just before serving, as the dressing separates as it stands.
Swap in basil, tarragon or mint depending on what the salad needs.
Add a little honey to soften the acidity for bitter leaves.
Add the herbs on the day you use it; they dull after a day in lemon.
storage: Keep the dressing without herbs in the sealed jar in the fridge for up to 3 days; with herbs, use within 1 day. Let it come to room temperature and shake before using, as the oil firms when cold. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
